summary: The simulation runs end-to-end and captures key drivers of mask adoption (social influence, policy, media, supply), but it has several major logic and design gaps: public-space mobility does not respond to mandates, enforcement filtering only operates when disease is enabled, and key spec features (RiskEnvironment, supply shortage tracking, time-to-threshold metrics, daily contacts mapping, restock interval) are missing or placeholders. Addressing these will materially improve fidelity, metric coverage, and alignment with the task specification.

critical_issues.issue: Public-space attendance ignores mandates due to hardcoded mandate_active = False in _attend_locations_today
critical_issues.impact: Mobility reduction under mandates never applies, biasing adoption-by-context and policy effect estimates; underestimates the combined effect of mandates on exposure and social influence in community settings.
critical_issues.solution: Pass the actual mandate_active flag into _attend_locations_today (or store it on the Simulation) and compute public-space attendance probability using that.

critical_issues.issue: Enforcement filtering (denying entry to unmasked where required) is only applied when disease is enabled
critical_issues.impact: Under the default no-disease setting, enforcement has no functional impact on attendance or adoption-by-context, distorting both outcomes and the DiD policy effect estimate.
critical_issues.solution: Unify enforcement filtering logic for both disease and non-disease branches in _host_contacts_and_transmissions; track enforcement actions consistently.

critical_issues.issue: RiskEnvironment entity from the spec is missing; risk is updated via an ad-hoc method
critical_issues.impact: Separating the risk environment improves modularity, enables exogenous/endogenous risk feedback, and supports experimentation with prevalence trends; current approach limits realism and extensibility.
critical_issues.solution: Implement a RiskEnvironment class with base_risk_index and prevalence_trend, integrate it into Simulation, and have it broadcast the risk signal that agents use to update risk perceptions.

critical_issues.issue: Key metrics are unimplemented or placeholders (supply_shortage_days, information_impact elasticity)
critical_issues.impact: Cannot evaluate supply and information channel effects per spec; results are incomplete for decision-making and comparisons.
critical_issues.solution: Track daily stockouts/unmet demand to compute supply_shortage_days; record campaign intensity and misinformation exposure to estimate adoption elasticity with respect to information intensity.

critical_issues.issue: Parameter mapping gaps (rewire_prob, daily_contacts_*), missing time_to_threshold 70%/90%
critical_issues.impact: Configuration values from the spec or examples are ignored, leading to unexpected behavior and incomplete metrics.
critical_issues.solution: Map rewire_prob to rewiring_prob_small_world; map daily_contacts_home/work/community into contact_rate_by_location; track and return time_to_reach_70_percent and time_to_reach_90_percent.

model_improvements.current_approach: Public-space mobility uses a fixed, mandate-agnostic probability; enforcement filtering is only applied if disease dynamics are enabled.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Use the current policy state (mandate_active) to reduce public-space attendance probability; apply enforcement filtering consistently regardless of disease mode.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More accurate adoption-by-context, policy effect size, and both-masked-contact metrics; improves internal consistency.

model_improvements.current_approach: Exogenous Gaussian bump via _update_risk_signal within Simulation.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Create a RiskEnvironment that maintains and broadcasts risk, allows exogenous schedules or endogenous coupling to infections, and supports policy-dependent risk perception.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Better modularity and realism; easier experimentation with scenarios and calibration to prevalence data.

model_improvements.current_approach: Retailers restock daily; supply_shortage_days is a placeholder; rationing per retailer not enforced in purchase decisions.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Honor restock_interval_days; track per-day stockouts and unmet demand; enforce retailer.rationing_limit_per_person; optionally implement household bulk purchases and allocation.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Accurate supply constraint representation; enables supply-related metrics and policy testing (e.g., rationing efficacy).

model_improvements.aspect: Social influence heterogeneity and network quality
model_improvements.current_approach: Peer influence weight is global; potential duplicate ties inflate perceived norms.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Multiply peer weight by individual susceptibility_to_social_influence; deduplicate social ties after generation.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic diffusion heterogeneity and stable network-based norms.

model_improvements.suggested_approach: Map daily_contacts_home/work/community spec params to contact rates; respect location capacities for public spaces.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Closer alignment to spec and more controllable contact dynamics.

code_improvements.modification: Pass mandate_active in, remove hardcoded False, and compute mobility reduction accordingly; enforce public-space capacity.
code_improvements.reason: Fix major logic bug and prevent capacity overflows.

code_improvements.modification: Apply enforcement filtering (allow_map) for both disease and non-disease branches; increment enforcement action counter consistently.
code_improvements.reason: Ensure enforcement affects outcomes regardless of disease being enabled.

code_improvements.modification: Map rewire_prob to rewiring_prob_small_world and daily_contacts_* to contact_rate_by_location defaults when present.
code_improvements.reason: Honor spec/example parameters and reduce user confusion.

code_improvements.modification: Track time_to_reach_70_percent and time_to_reach_90_percent; record supply shortage days.
code_improvements.reason: Complete the requested metrics and improve supply measurement.
Introduce agent heterogeneity in social influence uptake.

code_improvements.modification: Honor restock_interval_days (by passing day and checking modulo) and only restock on interval days.
code_improvements.reason: Align with the spec and more realistic supply cadence.

code_improvements.modification: Deduplicate social_ties for each person (convert to set then back to list).
code_improvements.reason: Prevent inflated neighbor norms due to duplicate ties.

code_improvements.modification: Compute SupplyShortageDays_Total from tracked daily shortage flags; provide a basic information impact elasticity estimate if campaign intensity varies.
code_improvements.reason: Replace placeholder metrics with meaningful values.

code_improvements.modification: Introduce a RiskEnvironment; remove or wrap _update_risk_signal to use risk_env.broadcast_risk.
code_improvements.reason: Implement the spec entity and improve modularity.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: No calibration against observed adoption curves; risk, media, and enforcement parameters are set a priori.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Calibrate peer/media/authority weights and mandate timing/enforcement to match known mask adoption trajectories (e.g., fit to regional time series using grid search or Bayesian optimization).

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: DiD compares high vs low enforcement locations but not against a no-mandate counterfactual.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Run a counterfactual scenario with mandates disabled or enforcement set to zero and compute DiD vs this counterfactual for cleaner attribution.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Income-based Gini is computed but not tied to price/supply constraints explicitly.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Estimate price elasticity by income group and adjust perceived_mask_cost and purchasing budgets accordingly; validate against observed disparities where available.
Track retailer stockouts and unmet demand; validate shortages timing against known supply disruptions (e.g., early pandemic months).
Vary campaign_intensity over exogenous schedules; compute elasticity as %Δ adoption per %Δ intensity; compare qualitative magnitude with known effects from public campaigns.

prioritized_actions: Fix public-space mobility under mandates by passing mandate_active into _attend_locations_today and enforcing capacity.
Apply enforcement filtering in both disease and non-disease branches; count enforcement actions consistently.
Map rewire_prob and daily_contacts_* parameters; add time_to_reach_70_percent and time_to_reach_90_percent.
Track supply shortage days (stockouts/unmet demand) and implement restock_interval_days.
Use susceptibility_to_social_influence in Person.decide_wear_mask and deduplicate social ties.
Introduce RiskEnvironment and integrate for risk broadcasting.
Implement household bulk purchasing and allocation to better model shared resources.
Replace placeholder information impact metric with an elasticity estimate based on varying campaign intensity.
additional_comments: Consider disabling visualize() during automated runs or guarding it behind a config flag to avoid potential blocking or extraneous output in headless environments. Also remove redundant pass statements before executable code to improve readability. np_rng is currently unused; either leverage it for vectorized draws or remove it.

change_analysis.summary: The recent iteration substantially expanded the code, added metrics collection, DiD policy effect, and improved normalization. However, several core logic issues remain: mandate-aware mobility is still hardcoded off; enforcement filtering remains inactive without disease; and some spec entities and metrics are placeholders.
positive_impacts: Introduced DiD-like policy effect computation (adoption_high_enforcement vs adoption_low_enforcement).
Added both-masked contact share and adoption churn rate series.
Improved configuration normalization and internal mapping for several keys.
Enforcement actions counter added (though only triggered in one branch).
negative_impacts: Mandate-aware public-space attendance still ignores mandates due to hardcoded False.
Enforcement filtering applies only when disease is enabled, creating inconsistency.
Spec entity RiskEnvironment still missing; risk updates are ad hoc.
Restock interval parameter and daily contacts spec parameters remain unused.
suggestions: Unify enforcement logic across branches and fix mandate-aware mobility in attendance.
Implement RiskEnvironment and integrate it for risk broadcasting.
Honor restock intervals and daily contact parameters from the spec.
Complete missing time-to-threshold metrics and supply/information metrics.
